layout_notes: Lead with the most commercially useful services.
Use varied row or feature-list composition before any card grid.
conversion_notes: Connect each service group to the primary CTA.
avoid: More than one repeated three-card grid

layout_notes: Treat services as offerings, menu items, classes, or appointments as appropriate.
conversion_notes: Move visitors toward booking, menu viewing, ordering, or visiting.
avoid: Calling hospitality menu content generic services

layout_notes: Explain service fit and next step without overpromising.
Use proof or locality near service explanations.
